title: Taga Castle
scope: The surviving central government enclosure of Taga Castle, with its main hall plinth, associated excavated foundations, low perimeter banks and south approach.
limitations: The modeled scope covers the present central archaeological enclosure and immediate approach. The modern full-sized outer gate is south of this scope.
The visible plinth and bank heights use the native terrain and exterior photographs. Small marker stones, gravel edges and individual stair risers are representative.
